# Deployment & Infrastructure
<!-- docs.AI knowledge doc — auto-generated by speckit.init -->

## Distribution Model

AI Radija Tools is distributed as a Claude Code plugin (primary) and via manual install scripts (secondary).

### Claude Code Plugin Install (Primary)

```bash
claude plugin add https://github.com/<org>/ai-radija-tools
```

- Discovers skills via `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
- Skills auto-discovered in `.claude/skills/` after install
- Updates: re-run `claude plugin add <url>` to get the latest version

**Plugin manifest** (`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`):
```json
{
  "name": "ai-radija-tools",
  "version": "2.1.4",
  "description": "...",
  "skills": "./skills"
}
```

### Manual Install — Codex CLI / Antigravity

```bash
# Bash
./install.sh codex /path/to/project

# PowerShell
.\install.ps1 -Model codex -ProjectRoot C:\path\to\project
```

- Installs skills to `.agents/skills/` (Codex) or equivalent adapter target
- Adapters in `adapters/*.json` map skill names to resolved paths
- Supports three models: `claude`, `codex`, `antigravity`

---

## Version Management

- **Scheme**: Semantic versioning — `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`
- **Current**: v2.1.4
- **Breaking changes**: Require a `MAJOR` bump (template format is frozen in v2.x)
- **Backward compatibility**: Skills are only added between minor versions, never removed

---

## Generated Infrastructure (ai-radija-bootstrap)

For Radija projects, the `ai-radija-bootstrap` skill generates project scaffolding including:

| Artifact | Path |
|---------|------|
| CI/CD pipeline YAML | `infra/pipeline/` |
| Database migrations | `database/migrations/` |
| .gitignore | project root |
| README template | project root |

**Cloud platforms supported**:
- Azure (primary): App Service, AKS, Container Apps, Azure Functions
- AWS: referenced but not primary (Azure-first)
- On-premises: supported with LGPD data residency caveats

---

## CI/CD Integration

Projects bootstrapped with `ai-radija-bootstrap` can target:
- **Azure DevOps Pipelines** (recommended)
- **GitHub Actions** (supported)
- **GitLab CI** (mentioned, scaffold not detailed)

The skill generates pipeline YAML scaffolds per stack choice at bootstrap time.

---

## No Server Infrastructure

AI Radija Tools itself has no servers, containers, or databases. It is a static collection of Markdown files installed locally into a project repository.
